topic: Gathering data for AI knowledge base
summary_markdown:
The team is developing a Customer Support AI Agent and requires more comprehensive data for its knowledge base. Currently, the agent only has access to three PDFs: translations from analytics and privacy policy pages from allunite.com, meaning it lacks knowledge regarding footfall.

Participants discussed the need for consistent and non-deprecated terminology. It was suggested that starting with basic vocabulary definitions (e.g., Frame, Facility, Insertion duration) is crucial because clients often use their own naming systems. A document containing standardized terminology will be created and shared to aid in building the bot's knowledge base.
decisions: A centralized location was provided for uploading appropriate files and comments (Google Drive link).
action_items: Create a document defining standard terminology for the AI agent's knowledge base.
